title: 20 Years of Job Search Advice in 26 Minutes (I've hired 1,000+ people)
description:
If you want to know how to find a job, I have 20 years of job search tips and career advice to share from how to write an ATS friendly resume, what hiring managers actually want to see, how to find a job on LinkedIn, and everything in between. I’m Dave Fano, and I was the Chief Growth Officer at WeWork and founder of Teal, and I’ve been on the other end of the job hunt. 

I’ve seen what job search strategies work and what doesn’t. If you want to learn how to find a job that pays well, aligns with your skills, and gives you the work-life balance you deserve, these job search tips are for you!
